title: STK
description: Documented public mission modeling platform (Ansys) for the Spacecraft Systems Simulator capability area.
body:
STK is a documented mission modeling platform from Ansys. Digital mission engineering: models spacecraft power, thermal, comms, and sensors together against mission timelines.

How it works: It works by summing the load list against the generation capacity and reporting the margin in watts and percent.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.

title: FreeFlyer
description: Documented public mission analysis software (a.i. solutions) for the Spacecraft Systems Simulator capability area.
body:
FreeFlyer is a documented mission analysis software from a.i. solutions. Covers orbit, coverage, link, and maneuver analysis in one scriptable environment for spacecraft operations.

How it works: It works by adding EIRP, subtracting free-space path loss, adding receive G/T and Boltzmann's constant to get C/N0, then comparing against the requirement.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.

title: Copernicus
description: Documented public trajectory design system (NASA Johnson) for the Spacecraft Systems Simulator capability area.
body:
Copernicus is a documented trajectory design system from NASA Johnson. High-fidelity trajectory and maneuver planning integrated with spacecraft constraint modeling.

How it works: It works by computing the two Hohmann transfer burns from the vis-viva equation and the half-ellipse transfer time.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.
